function displayCase(v) {
  document.body.innerHTML='';document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';document.documentElement.style.cssText='';
  const parent=document.createElement('main');document.body.append(parent);const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.append(sheet);
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.id='target';parent.append(e);const s=getComputedStyle(e),checks={};
  const inputs=['inline','inline-block','inline-flex','inline-grid','inline-table','table-row','contents','flow-root','inline flow-root','inline ruby','inline list-item','block flow-root'];
  const normal=['inline','inline-block','inline-flex','inline-grid','inline-table','table-row','contents','flow-root','inline-block','ruby','inline list-item','flow-root'];
  const transformed=['block','block','flex','grid','table','block','contents','flow-root','block','block ruby','list-item','flow-root'];
  for(const display of ['block','flex','grid','none']){parent.style.display=display;for(let i=0;i<inputs.length;i++){e.style.display=inputs[i];checks[display+'Scalar'+i]=s.display===(['flex','grid'].includes(display)?transformed[i]:normal[i])&&s.getPropertyValue('display')===s.display;}}
  for(const [i,value] of ['inline','inline-block','inline-flex','inline-grid','contents','none','table-row'].entries()){document.documentElement.style.display=value;checks['root'+i]=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).display===['block','block','flex','grid','block','none','block'][i];}
  document.documentElement.style.display='';parent.style.display='block';
  const check=(name,css,expected,rules='')=>{sheet.textContent=rules;e.style.cssText=css;checks[name]=s.display===expected&&s.getPropertyValue('display')===expected;};
  check('default','','block');check('initial','display:initial','inline');check('unset','display:unset','inline');check('revert','display:revert','block');check('inherit','display:inherit','block');
  check('twoKeywords','display:block flex','flex');check('reverseKeywords','display:flex block','flex');check('variable','--kind:inline grid;display:var(--kind)','inline-grid');check('fallback','display:var(--missing,inline flex)','inline-flex');check('invalidVariable','display:var(--missing)','inline');check('invalidVariableValue','--kind:20px;display:var(--kind)','inline');check('registered','display:var(--kind)','inline','@property --kind{syntax:"<custom-ident>";inherits:false;initial-value:inline}');
  check('specificity','','flex','div{display:block}#target{display:flex}');check('sourceOrder','','grid','#target{display:flex}#target{display:grid}');check('inline','display:flex','flex','#target{display:grid}');check('important','display:flex','grid','#target{display:grid!important}');check('layers','','grid','@layer early,late;@layer early{#target{display:flex}}@layer late{div{display:grid}}');check('importantLayers','','flex','@layer early,late;@layer early{div{display:flex!important}}@layer late{#target{display:grid!important}}');
  sheet.textContent='';e.style.cssText='display:inline';e.style.position='absolute';checks.absolute=s.display==='block';e.style.position='fixed';checks.fixed=s.display==='block';e.style.position='static';e.style.float='left';checks.float=s.display==='block';e.style.float='none';
  e.style.display='flex';for(const [i,value] of ['20px','block block','run-in','inline,block'].entries()){e.style.display=value;checks['invalid'+i]=s.display==='flex';}
  e.style.setProperty('DISPLAY','inline grid','important');checks.cssom=s.display==='inline-grid'&&e.style.display==='inline-grid'&&e.style.getPropertyPriority('display')==='important';checks.removal=e.style.removeProperty('display')==='inline-grid'&&s.display==='block';
  e.style.display='inline-block';parent.style.display='flex';checks.liveParent=s.display==='block';parent.style.display='block';checks.liveParentReset=s.display==='inline-block';sheet.textContent='#target{display:grid}';e.style.display='';checks.liveSheet=s.display==='grid';sheet.textContent='#target{display:flex}';checks.liveSheetMutation=s.display==='flex';sheet.textContent='';
  const wrapper=document.createElement('div');wrapper.style.display='contents';parent.append(wrapper);wrapper.append(e);parent.style.display='flex';e.style.display='inline-block';checks.contentsContext=s.display==='block';parent.append(e);wrapper.remove();
  checks.enumeration=Array.from({length:s.length},(_,i)=>s.item(i)).filter(name=>name==='display').length===1;checks.priority=s.getPropertyPriority('display')==='';checks.uppercaseRead=s.getPropertyValue('DISPLAY')==='block';try{s.display='none';checks.readOnly=false;}catch(error){checks.readOnly=error.name==='NoModificationAllowedError';}
  e.remove();checks.detached=s.display==='';parent.append(e);checks.reattached=s.display==='block';
  const external=document.createElement('div');external.id='external';parent.append(external);checks.external=getComputedStyle(external).display===(v%2?'grid':'flex');external.remove();
  e.style.cssText='width:'+(v+3)+'px;height:'+(v%9+5)+'px';
  for(const kind of ['flex','grid']){parent.style.cssText='display:'+kind+';width:200px;height:100px';for(const [i,display] of ['inline','inline-block','inline-flex','inline-grid','table-row'].entries()){e.style.display=display;const box=e.getBoundingClientRect();checks[kind+'Geometry'+i]=box.width===v+3&&box.height===v%9+5&&s.display===['block','block','flex','grid','block'][i];}}
  sheet.remove();document.body.innerHTML='';document.documentElement.style.cssText='display:inline;width:40px;height:10px';const rootBox=document.documentElement.getBoundingClientRect();checks.rootGeometry=rootBox.width===40&&rootBox.height===10&&getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).display==='block';document.documentElement.style.cssText='';return checks;
}
